# Edit Log — 2026-09-03

## v131.9 — 2026-09-03 — Change (changelog): translate displayed entry titles/scopes to Arabic

**Why:** The "سجل التحديثات" (Latest Updates) tab's headings and badge labels were already Arabic, but each entry's title/scope came straight from `LATEST_UPDATES` (auto-generated from `docs/edit logs/*.md`), which are written in English per this file's own convention — leaving the visible list mixed-language even though the rest of the page is RTL Arabic. Hand-editing the generated data file wasn't viable (`npm run generate:changelog` overwrites it), and requiring bilingual edit-log entries going forward was out of scope for this change.

**What changed:** Added `src/data/changelog/titleTranslations.ts`, a version-keyed lookup (`TITLE_TRANSLATIONS`) and scope-slug lookup (`SCOPE_TRANSLATIONS`) providing Arabic display text for the entries currently in `LATEST_UPDATES`; entries with no mapping fall back to their raw English text so nothing silently disappears. `Changelog/index.tsx` now renders `translateTitle(entry.version, entry.title)` and `translateScope(entry.scope)` instead of the raw fields. The edit-log source files and the generator script are untouched — only the on-screen text changes.

**File:** `dist/index.html`

**File:** `package.json`

**File:** `src/components/Sidebar/Tabs/Changelog/index.tsx`

**File:** `src/data/changelog/titleTranslations.ts (new)`

**Before:**
```tsx
<p className="chg-title">
  {entry.scope && <span className="chg-scope">({entry.scope})</span>} {entry.title}
</p>
```

**After:**
```tsx
const scope = translateScope(entry.scope);
const title = translateTitle(entry.version, entry.title);
// ...
<p className="chg-title">
  {scope && <span className="chg-scope">({scope})</span>} {title}
</p>
```

**Verification:** `npm run lint` — clean. `npm run typecheck` — clean. `npm run test:run` — 457 files / 4330 tests passed. `npm run build` — succeeded (dist/index.html 4,487.10 kB raw / 1,459.85 kB gzip, well under the 30 MB/10 MB budget). `npm run check:release` — bumped `package.json` to 131.9.0 to match this entry (CI's `check:release` failed on the first push over the mismatch). `npm run check:vendor`, `check:complexity`, `check:hex-literals`, `check:bundle-size` — all clean.

**Lines:** 3 files, +317 / -262
